mood_contract: Mechanical rescue: the student can see which measured method worked without pretending quality is solved.

intended_learnings.text: You do not pick a quality check because someone said so: run several on your own output against a benchmark and keep the winner.
Grounded means every claim traces to a source; a fluent claim with no source is the failure to catch.
The winning method becomes a reusable judge file that names what it catches and where it stops.
A narrow judge that works beats a broad one that pretends; name the limits the judge cannot reach.
